name: Google AI Studio
desc: Free web playground for prompting Gemini models
desc_zh: 在浏览器里调试和对比 Gemini 模型的免费工作台
solves: You cannot tell a good prompt from a lucky one by reading it. Run two variants against the same input and the difference is right there.
solves_zh: 光读是分不出好 prompt 和走运的。把两个变体喂同一个输入，差别当场就看出来了。
best_for: Prompt work before it reaches an app: compare two models on the same input and keep the settings.
best_for_zh: prompt 接进应用之前的调试与对比：同一组输入换两个模型，设置原样保留。
notes: 2026-11-25：status merged → active; superseded_by gemini-enterprise → null。原记录写「已并入 Gemini Enterprise」没有依据：Google 发布 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 的文章通篇没有提到 AI Studio，只把 Vertex AI 列为前身；aistudio.google.com 至今在线，页面标题是「Google AI Studio | Build with the Gemini API」 2026-11-25：desc "Free web playground for prompting, now inside Gemini Enterprise" → "Free web playground for prompting Gemini models"。去掉「now inside Gemini Enterprise」 2026-11-25：desc_zh "免费网页 prompt 工作台，已并入 Gemini Enterprise" → "在浏览器里调试和对比 Gemini 模型的免费工作台"。去掉「已并入 Gemini Enterprise」 2026-11-25：best_for "Prompt work before it reaches an app. It has since folded into Gemini Enterprise." → "Prompt work before it reaches an app: compare two models on the same input and keep the settings."。去掉「It has since folded into Gemini Enterprise」 2026-11-25：best_for_zh "prompt 接进应用之前的调试与对比，现在已经并入 Gemini Enterprise 平台。" → "prompt 接进应用之前的调试与对比：同一组输入换两个模型，设置原样保留。"。去掉「现在已经并入 Gemini Enterprise 平台」
